name: 80 mm wheel for NEMA 17 (5 mm D shaft)
source: Typical 80 mm rubber robot wheel with a 5 mm D-bore aluminium hub (NEMA 17 shaft)
notes: Rubber tyre, 80 mm diameter, 30 mm wide, aluminium hub with a 5 mm D bore and an M3 grub screw. Pushes onto a NEMA 17's 5 mm shaft (flat against the grub screw). Axis along z.
